package usecase

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/infrastructure/persistence/memory"
)

func TestBuildAndBugfixPilotsReachVerifiedPrivateStagingWithoutKnowledgeTree(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name      string
		file      string
		jobID     string
		candidate domain.AuthoringCandidateV1
		taskType  string
		surface   string
	}{
		{name: "tic-tac-toe v1 practice", file: "tic-tac-toe.request.json", jobID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", candidate: validCandidate(), taskType: "BUILD", surface: domain.SurfaceClassificationPractice},
		{name: "counter v2 project", file: "bugfix-counter.request.json", jobID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", candidate: bugfixCandidate(), taskType: "BUGFIX", surface: domain.SurfaceClassificationProject},
	}
	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			payload, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("..", "..", "testdata", "pilots", test.file))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			var request domain.PlanningRequestV1
			if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &request); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			repository := memory.NewJobRepository()
			stager := &stagerStub{}
			workspaces := &workspaceStub{}
			competencies := &competencyStub{}
			if test.taskType == "BUGFIX" {
				competencies.targets = []domain.LearningTargetDescriptor{{Ref: domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: "capability", Key: "javascript.event-state", Version: "v1"}, Title: "Event state", Description: "Manage event-driven state"}}
			}
			planner := newTestPlanner(repository, &generatorStub{candidate: test.candidate}, competencies, validationStub{passed: true}, workspaces)
			planner.Stager = stager
			job, created, err := planner.Plan(context.Background(), test.jobID, request)
			if err != nil || !created || job.Status != domain.JobStatusReady || job.Artifact == nil || !job.Artifact.Verification.Passed {
				t.Fatalf("job=%+v created=%v err=%v", job, created, err)
			}
			if job.Artifact.Candidate.Blueprint.Classification.TaskType != test.taskType ||
				job.Artifact.Candidate.Blueprint.Classification.SurfaceClassification != test.surface ||
				len(workspaces.created) != 3 || len(workspaces.deleted) != 3 || stager.calls != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("type=%s workspaces=%v/%v", job.Artifact.Candidate.Blueprint.Classification.TaskType, workspaces.created, workspaces.deleted)
			}
			staged, err := planner.Stage(context.Background(), job.ID)
			if err != nil || staged.Staging == nil || staged.Status != domain.JobStatusStaged || stager.calls != 1 ||
				stager.artifact.Candidate.Blueprint.Classification.SurfaceClassification != test.surface {
				t.Fatalf("staged=%+v calls=%d err=%v", staged, stager.calls, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func bugfixCandidate() domain.AuthoringCandidateV1 {
	candidate := validCandidate()
	blueprint := &candidate.Blueprint
	blueprint.Identity = domain.BlueprintIdentity{FamilyKey: "broken-counter", VariantKey: "javascript-race-bugfix-junior"}
	blueprint.Classification.TaskType = "BUGFIX"
	blueprint.Classification.Stacks = []string{"html", "javascript"}
	blueprint.Difficulty = domain.Difficulty{Implementation: 2, Algorithms: 1, Architecture: 2, Debugging: 3, Ambiguity: 2, Autonomy: 3, DerivedLevel: "junior"}
	blueprint.Scenario = domain.Scenario{
		Title: "Потерянное обновление счётчика", Goal: "Воспроизвести и исправить потерю обновления при быстрых кликах",
		Roles:        []string{"support_engineer"},
		Requirements: []domain.Requirement{{ID: "req-counter", Text: "Каждый клик увеличивает счётчик ровно на единицу"}},
		Constraints:  []string{"Сохранить публичный DOM contract"}, NonGoals: []string{"Переписывание приложения"},
	}
	blueprint.Acceptance = []domain.AcceptanceCriterion{{ID: "acc-counter", Text: "Два быстрых клика дают приращение на два", EvidenceKind: "deterministic"}}
	blueprint.Milestones = []domain.Milestone{{
		ID: "m-diagnose", Title: "Диагностика и исправление", Objective: "Устранить воспроизводимую потерю обновления", AcceptanceIDs: []string{"acc-counter"},
		Steps: []domain.Step{{ID: "s-fix", Title: "Исправить обработчик", Objective: "Найти root cause и внести минимальное исправление", Deliverables: []string{"app.js"}, AcceptanceIDs: []string{"acc-counter"},
			LearningRequirements:     []domain.LearningRequirement{{ID: "learn-events", Target: domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: "capability", Key: "javascript.event-state", Version: "v1"}, Policy: "adaptive", MasteryThreshold: .7}},
			ValidationRequirementIDs: []string{"check-counter"}, EstimatedEffortMinutes: 45}},
	}}
	blueprint.Runtime.StarterWorkspace.Files = []domain.WorkspaceFile{{Path: "index.html", Content: `<button id="increment">+</button><output id="count">0</output>`}, {Path: "app.js", Content: `button.onclick = () => setTimeout(() => count.textContent = Number(count.textContent) + 1, 0)`}}
	blueprint.Evaluation.Validator.Checks = []domain.ValidatorCheck{{ID: "check-counter", Kind: "browser_behavior", Visibility: "private", AcceptanceIDs: []string{"acc-counter"}}}
	blueprint.Traceability = []domain.TraceabilityLink{{RequirementID: "req-counter", AcceptanceIDs: []string{"acc-counter"}, ValidatorCheckIDs: []string{"check-counter"}, LearningRequirementIDs: []string{"learn-events"}}}
	candidate.PrivateEvaluation.Reference.Files = []domain.WorkspaceFile{{Path: "index.html", Content: `<button id="increment">+</button><output id="count">0</output>`}, {Path: "app.js", Content: `button.onclick = () => count.textContent = Number(count.textContent) + 1`}}
	candidate.PrivateEvaluation.Negatives = []domain.NamedFixture{{ID: "lost-update", Workspace: candidate.Blueprint.Runtime.StarterWorkspace.Fixture()}}
	return candidate
}
